data.title: Dhu Al-Hulaifah Miqat Mosque Welcomes over 15 Million Visitors in 2025
data.content:
Madinah, January 8, 2026, SPA -- Dhu Al-Hulaifah Miqat Mosque in Madinah received more than 15 million visitors during 2025, following the implementation of extensive development projects and service enhancements aimed at improving the experience of pilgrims and umrah performers.
    The initiatives formed part of an integrated service system designed to increase operational efficiency and ensure high-quality services for pilgrims and visitors.  Key upgrades included installing over 100 water distribution points in the mosque courtyards, modernizing the lighting system with approximately 7,000 lighting units, and enhancing the audio system with 190 advanced speakers and amplifiers.
    To accommodate the high number of visitors, more than 1,300 restrooms and ablution facilities were developed and rehabilitated, improving accessibility and overall facility readiness. The mosque also upgraded its guidance and wayfinding system by installing more than 30 directional signs, laid more than 2,400 square meters of prayer carpets, and rehabilitated more than 12,000 square meters of marble and porcelain flooring throughout the mosque and surrounding courtyards.
    Additional improvements included installing more than 40 fans to enhance comfort, over 50 lighting poles to improve courtyard illumination, and preparing more than 480 designated bus parking spaces to support traffic management and facilitate visitor access.
    The mosque has made significant improvements in the services it provides to worshipers. These improvements include human-centered upgrades to courtyards and facilities, as well as strengthened organizational and operational readiness. Such efforts have increased reception efficiency and enhanced the visitor experience, with the mosque’s capacity now exceeding 15,000 worshippers.
    These initiatives fall under the mandate of the Madinah Region Development Authority, which, in partnership with the Pilgrim Experience Program and all relevant entities. The efforts align with the objectives of Saudi Vision 2030.
    -- SPA
